info.title: BMW to RSA Provider (OpenAPI 3.1)
info.description: REST API provided by the RSA Provider to receive and manage RSA cases and services.

get.summary: Returns a case assosiated with the given bmwCaseId

parameters.name: bmwCaseId
parameters.description: Identifier of a case, initially set by BMW OSA system.

post.description: Create an on-site assistance case and associated services in the provider's system

externalCaseId.description: Identifier of the case in the provider's system created in response to this request.

externalServiceIds.description: Identifier of the service in the provider's system created in response to this request.

get.summary: Returns a service assosiated with the given bmwServiceId

parameters.name: bmwCaseId
parameters.description: case to get the services of

delete.summary: Cancel a service of a case
delete.description: Cancel an already existing on-site assistance service from an already ordered case. Returns the canceled service.

parameters.name: bmwCaseId
parameters.description: case to get the services of

post.summary: Add new services to a case
post.description: Add one or more on-site assistance services to an already ordered case

parameters.name: bmwCaseId
parameters.description: The identifier of a case to add a service to

externalServiceId.description: Identifier of the service in the provider's system created in response to this request.

get.summary: Returns a list of services for a case
get.description: Get all on-site assistance services of an already ordered case

parameters.name: bmwCaseId
parameters.description: case to get the services of

ErrorResponseTO.description: Response in case of an error

message.description: Detailed human readable error message describing the failure.

RsaCaseTO.description: Representation of an RSA case including customer, vehicle, eligibility and ordered services.

bmwCaseId.description: The unique case identifier, set by BMW OSA system.

createdAt.description: When the case has been initially created by BMW OSA system. Timestamp incl. timezone in ISO-8601 format.

updatedAt.description: When the case has been updated by BMW OSA system. Timestamp incl. timezone in ISO-8601 format.

goodwill.description: If TRUE, vehicle is covered independently of eligibilityStatus (explicitly set by Call Center Customer Agent in BMW OSA system).

priority.description: This flag indicates if a case has priority over other cases. Granted by Call Center Customer Agent in BMW OSA system, e.g. if there are small children onboard, the Agent will set this to TRUE.

vip.description: Flag indicating VIP status; may influence handling priority.

gkl.description: Flag indicating BMW Große Klasse (luxury class) which may influence service handling.

customerCountryCodeIso.description: The country of the customer. In ISO 3166 Alpha-2 country code.

breakdownLocationCountryCodeIso.description: The country of the location where the breakdown occured. In ISO 3166 Alpha-2 country code.

solutionLinkUrl.description: Link to the Adaptive Solution Database.

passengersNumberAdults.description: How many adults are in the breakdown vehicle?

passengersNumberChildren.description: How many children are in the breakdown vehicle?

hasCustomerLuggage.description: Does the customer have luggage? True if yes.

hasTrailer.description: Does the vehicle has a trailer? True if yes.

hasCustomerPets.description: Does the customer have pets? True if yes.

hasRoofBox.description: Does the vehicle have a roof box? True if yes.

hasBikeRack.description: Does the vehicle have a bike rack? True if yes.

breakdownCodes.description: List of breakdown reasons/symptoms codes, e.g. ['1850', '1310']. These codes are known in BMW systems.

examples: Nails in the tire, Damage to the Suspension.
suspectedBreakdownReason.description: Detailed description of the breakdown reasons.

ContactTO.description: Contact details of the customer associated with the case.

firstName.description: The first name of the customer.

lastName.description: The last name of the customer

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the customer. Including the phone country code.

isMobilePhoneNumber.description: Is the phone number a mobile one?

customerLanguageCodeIso.description: The language and country of the customer. Language as ISO 639-1, country as ISO 3166 Alpha-2.

EligibilityTO.description: Eligibility information returned from BMW EGB system describing whether the vehicle is covered and warranty periods.

status.description: The EGB status of the customer's vehicle, calculated by BMW EGB system.

programName.description: The name of the EGB program.

warrantyStartsAt.description: Start of warranty coverage period. In ISO-8601 format.

warrantyEndsAt.description: End of warranty coverage period. In ISO-8601 format.

VehicleTO.description: Vehicle information related to the case.

vin.description: The vehicle identification number of the vehicle.

isOwnershipBMW.description: Is this vehicle from an internal BMW vehicles pool.

ownershipType.description: From which type is the BMW ownership?

productionYear.description: The production year of the vehicle.

developmentCode.description: The development code of the vehicle model.

isDigitalKeyUsage.description: Does the vehicle use a digital key?

mileageInKm.description: How many kilometers did the car run?

avgDistanceTravelledPerWeekInKm.description: Number of kilometers the car drives in average in one week.

engineOilLevelPercentage.description: Oil Level of the engine as percentage.

batteryConditionPercentage.description: State of charge of the 12V Battery as percentage.

coolerTemperatureInCelsius.description: Temperature of the engine coolant in degrees Celsius.

outsideTemperatureInCelsius.description: Ambient temperature at the breakdown location in degrees Celsius.

tirePressure.description: Tire pressures for each wheel measured in bar.

frontRightInBar.description: Pressure of the front right tire in bar.

frontLeftInBar.description: Pressure of the front left tire in bar.

rearRightInBar.description: Pressure of the rear right tire in bar.

rearLeftInBar.description: Pressure of the rear left tire in bar.

stateOfChargePercentage.description: Battery charge of electric vehicles in percentage.

propulsionType.description: What type of fuel or propulsion the vehicle uses (e.g., Hybrid, Diesel, Electric).

dtcs.description: Diagnostic trouble codes created by the vehicle in case of a problem.

ServiceTO.description: Representation of a service attached to a case. Uses a discriminator (serviceType) to specify the concrete service sub-type.

bmwServiceId.description: The unique identifier of a service, set by BMW OSA system.

serviceDetails.description: Service specific details. One of the service sub-schemas (RRV, TOWING, TAXI, etc.) must be provided and is identified by the serviceType discriminator.

serviceType.description: The type of the ordered RSA service.

scheduledAt.description: When is the service scheduled by Call Center Agent? In ISO-8601 format.

note.description: Notes that the OSA Call Center Agent can add for the RSA Provider.

isCustomerOnSite.description: Indicates whether the customer is physically present at the breakdown location.

isEnoughSpace.description: Indicates whether there is enough space at the breakdown location to perform the required work.

locationType.description: Classification of the location type where the service will be performed.

isRepatriation.description: If the service is part of a repatriation.

TowingTO.description: Towing service details including start/target locations and towing category.

serviceType.description: The type of the ordered RSA service.

towCategory.description: Which kind of towing is needed?

isVehicleAutomatic.description: Is the vehicle automatic? Transmission type.

scheduledAt.description: When is the service scheduled by Call Center Agent? In ISO-8601 format.

isRepatriation.description: If the service is part of a repatriation.

servicePartnerName.description: The name of the BMW dealer IF the drop off location is a BMW DEALER.

servicePartnerPhoneNumber.description: The phone number of the BMW dealer IF the drop off location is a BMW DEALER.

canVehicleBeMoved.description: Can the vehicle be moved TRUE or is it blocked? FALSE.

isEngineStartable.description: Can the engine of the vehicle be started?

isEnoughSpace.description: Is there enough space to work on the vehicle?

locationType.description: Classification of the location where towing will take place.

dropOffTo.description: Where the vehicle should be dropped off.

note.description: Notes that the OSA Call Center Agent can add for the RSA Provider.

if.description: Conditional schema fragment used to indicate additional repatriation related constraints (kept for compatibility).

then.description: Additional required fields and structure when repatriation is true.

vehicleCondition.description: Condition information about the vehicle for repatriation.

isRepaired.description: Whether the vehicle has been repaired.

isRollable.description: Whether the vehicle can be rolled/transported under its own wheels.

latestArrivalAtDestinationAt.description: Latest acceptable arrival time at destination. In ISO-8601 format.

pickUpContact.description: Details of the pick up contact; different structures depending on contact type.

examples: Please call Mr. BMW for correct address
noteForPickUp.description: Optional note for pick up instructions.

dropOffContact.description: Details for the drop off contact; structure varies by contact type.

TaxiTO.description: Taxi service details including passenger counts and trip metadata.

serviceType.description: The type of the ordered RSA service.

note.description: Notes that the OSA Call Center Agent can add for the RSA Provider.

scheduledAt.description: When is the service scheduled by Call Center Agent? In ISO-8601 format.

isRepatriation.description: If the service is part of a repatriation.

isPrepaymentCustomer.description: If the customer will pay for this service in advance.

category.description: Category of taxi service (e.g., PREMIUM or STANDARD).

numberAdults.description: How many adults are relevant for this service?

numberChildren.description: How many children are relevant for this service?

departureDateTime.description: The day and time the service is supposed to start the journey. In ISO-8601 format.

arrivalDateTime.description: The day and time the service is supposed to end the journey. In ISO-8601 format.

LocalPassengerTransportTO.description: Local passenger transport service details (e.g., shuttle or transfer).

serviceType.description: The type of the ordered RSA service.

note.description: Notes that the OSA Call Center Agent can add for the RSA Provider.

scheduledAt.description: When is the service scheduled by Call Center Agent? In ISO-8601 format.

isRepatriation.description: If the service is part of a repatriation.

isPrepaymentCustomer.description: If the customer will pay for this service in advance.

category.description: Category of the local passenger transport service.

numberAdults.description: How many adults are relevant for this service?

numberChildren.description: How many children are relevant for this service?

departureDateTime.description: The day and time the service is supposed to start the journey. In ISO-8601 format.

arrivalDateTime.description: The day and time the service is supposed to end the journey. In ISO-8601 format.

ReplacementVehicleTO.description: Replacement vehicle service details including reservation and driver information.

serviceType.description: The service type of the ordered RSA service.

isProlongation.description: Indicates if the reservation is a prolongation of an existing one.

examples: 1000 char free text. Mandadotry if isProlongation = true
prolongationNote.description: Explanation when the reservation is a prolongation.

isRepatriation.description: If the service is part of a repatriation.

category.description: The replacement vehicle category that is ordered.

note.description: Notes that the OSA Call Center Agent can add for the RSA Provider.

isPrepaymentCustomer.description: If the customer will pay for this service in advance.

additionalDriverFirstName.description: First name of an additional driver, if any.

additionalDriverLastName.description: Last name of an additional driver, if any.

isDriverLicenseAvailable.description: If the driver license of the driver (customer) is available.

driverLicenseNumber.description: The license number of the driver (customer).

reservationFrom.description: Date/time from when the replacement car is needed. In ISO-8601 format.

reservationUntil.description: Date/time until when the replacement car is needed. In ISO-8601 format.

startLocation.description: The location where the vehicle will be picked up.

targetLocation.description: The location where the vehicle will be returned.

HotelTO.description: Hotel accommodation details for the customer.

serviceType.description: The type of the ordered RSA service.

reservationFrom.description: The date and time on which the customer will check in. In ISO-8601 format.

reservationUntil.description: The date and time on which the customer will check out. In ISO-8601 format.

isProlongation.description: Indicates if the hotel reservation is a prolongation.

examples: 1000 char free text. Mandatory if isProlongation = true
prolongationNote.description: Note describing the reason for prolongation when applicable.

isRepatriation.description: If the service is part of a repatriation.

isPrepaymentCustomer.description: If the customer will pay for this service in advance.

numberAdults.description: Number of adults in the reservation.

numberChildren.description: Number of children in the reservation.

note.description: Notes that the OSA Call Center Agent can add for the RSA Provider.

FlightTO.description: Flight booking details when a flight service is arranged.

serviceType.description: The type of the ordered RSA service.

isRepatriation.description: If the service is part of a repatriation.

numberAdults.description: Number of adult passengers for the flight booking.

numberChildren.description: Number of child passengers for the flight booking.

isPrepaymentCustomer.description: If the customer will pay for this service in advance.

note.description: Notes that the OSA Call Center Agent can add for the RSA Provider.

departureDateTime.description: The day and time the service is supposed to start the journey. In ISO-8601 format.

arrivalDateTime.description: The day and time the service is supposed to end the journey. In ISO-8601 format.

TrainTO.description: Train booking details when a train service is arranged.

serviceType.description: The type of the ordered RSA service.

isRepatriation.description: If the service is part of a repatriation.

numberAdults.description: Number of adult passengers for the train booking.

numberChildren.description: Number of child passengers for the train booking.

isPrepaymentCustomer.description: If the customer will pay for this service in advance.

note.description: Notes that the OSA Call Center Agent can add for the RSA Provider.

departureDateTime.description: The day and time the service is supposed to start the journey. In ISO-8601 format.

arrivalDateTime.description: The day and time the service is supposed to end the journey. In ISO-8601 format.

FerryTO.description: Ferry transport details when a ferry is booked as part of the service.

serviceType.description: The type of the ordered RSA service.

isRepatriation.description: If the service is part of a repatriation.

numberAdults.description: Number of adult passengers for the ferry booking.

numberChildren.description: Number of child passengers for the ferry booking.

isPrepaymentCustomer.description: If the customer will pay for this service in advance.

note.description: Notes that the OSA Call Center Agent can add for the RSA Provider.

LocationTO.description: Geographical and address information for a location used by services.

state.description: State or region of the location.

countryCodeIso.description: The country of the customer. In ISO 3166 Alpha-2 country code.

locationName.description: A human readable name for the location (e.g., 'BMW office parking').

directionOfTravel.description: Cardinal direction showing heading of a vehicle.

open_id_connect.description: OpenID Connect security scheme used for authenticating requests to the API. Replace openIdConnectUrl with the provider's discovery endpoint.
